title: 第13章 柏林大教堂第14章 别怕我来了
lines: 第13章柏林大教堂
夏天此刻一心沉浸在眼前的美景之中，对于权天睿的动作，也是没有特别的在意，所以这倒是让权天睿的心情，更是愉悦。
“你看那边。”
顺着夏天手指的方向，权天睿的瞳孔微缩，心像是被重重的敲击了下。
那是教堂。
“权太太，你是暗示我，我们婚礼在这里办吗？”
尽管知道这个小女人有可能不是这样的心思，但是他还是忍不住会这样去想。
听到权天睿的话，夏天恨不得抽自己一巴掌，她怎么就忘记了，这个男人是自己的丈夫，而且还是个她随时都想离婚的丈夫，可不是倾听她心事的男闺蜜。
“哪有，我只是觉得在这教堂结婚，应该是一件很神圣的事情，跟你有什么关系。”
权天睿挑眉，“你说呢？”什么关系，她说跟他说有什么关系。
夏天无语，她就不该嘴贱，说这个话题。
“啊哈……我好饿，吃饭吃饭。”
挣脱权天睿的怀抱，连忙跑去一旁的位置上做了下来，所以赶紧转移话题是关键。
对于她明显的转移话题，权天睿的双眸之中隐隐的有些失落，她终究还是不能好好的接受他们之间的关系。
看来，他是的好好的准备准备婚礼了，让整个天下的人都知道他们的关系，看她还怎么想着逃。
这次回来，他就没有想过让她就这样溜走了。
就算是用绑的，他也要将她绑在身边。
一连两天，夏天跟权天睿差不多将整个柏林的景点差不多都逛了一遍，唯独只有柏林大教堂没有去，开玩笑，那天晚上的事情她可没有忘记。
要是真的去了，恐怕到时候他就真的误以为她是要迫不及待的嫁给他了。
到了最后一天的下午，权天睿收到李锦打来的电话，两个聊了很长时间。
等到权天睿出来的时候，神色有些凝重。
“老婆，我有些重要的事情需要处理下，下午你自己玩儿，要是不想出去留在酒店也可以。”
夏天看着权天睿的神色，就知道是有事情要处理。
她自然不会无理取闹硬要他陪着自己，点了点头。
“我知道，你去忙吧！”
他能抽出几天来陪自己，也是很难得了。
权天睿收了手机，上前拥着夏天，深深地吻住了她的双唇。
对于权天睿的触碰，夏天没有了之前的拒绝，虽然她也从没有真的拒绝掉过。
“老婆，对不起，等我回去之后好好补偿你。”
随即便松开了夏天，夏天也猜测出事情恐怕有些严重，连忙挥了挥手。
而且，他们之间又不是说，真的有什么感情在，她自然不会很失落。
“快去吧！”
谁知道，权天睿剑眉一挑，带着几分邪邪的坏笑。
“肉偿。”
瞬间，夏天的脸被羞得通红，直接抄起靠枕就朝权天睿扔去。
权天睿直接伸手打落了飞来的靠枕，这才心情愉悦的转身去了书房。

Chapter 13 Berlin Cathedral
Xia Tian was immersed in the beautiful scenery in front of him at this moment, and did not pay special attention to Quan Tianrui's actions, so this made Quan Tianrui feel even more happy.
"Look over there."
Following the direction of Xia Tian's finger, Quan Tianrui's pupils shrank slightly, and his heart seemed to be hit hard.
That's the church.
"Mrs. Quan, are you implying to me that our wedding will be held here?"
Although he knew that this little woman might not have such thoughts, he still couldn't help but think so.
Hearing Quan Tianrui's words, Xia Tian wanted to slap herself. How could she forget that this man was her husband, and he was a husband she wanted to divorce at any time, not a male best friend who listened to her concerns.
"No way, I just think getting married in this church should be a very sacred thing. It has nothing to do with you."
Quan Tianrui raised his eyebrows, "What do you think?" What does it matter? She said it didn't matter if she told him.
Xia Tian is speechless, she shouldn't be so mean-mouthed and talk about this topic.
"Aha... I'm so hungry. Let's eat."
He broke away from Quan Tianrui's arms and quickly ran to the side to do it, so changing the topic quickly was the key.
Regarding her obvious change of topic, Quan Tianrui's eyes were slightly disappointed. After all, she still couldn't accept their relationship well.
It seems that he is well prepared to prepare for the wedding and let the whole world know about their relationship. Let's see how she still wants to escape.
When he came back this time, he never thought about letting her slip away like this.
Even if she was tied up, he would still tie her to his side.
For two days in a row, Xia Tian and Quan Tianrui visited almost all the attractions in Berlin, except the Berlin Cathedral. Just kidding, she has not forgotten what happened that night.
If she really goes, I'm afraid he will really mistakenly think that she can't wait to marry him.
On the afternoon of the last day, Quan Tianrui received a call from Li Jin, and the two chatted for a long time.
When Quan Tianrui came out, his expression was a little solemn.
"Honey, I have some important things to take care of. You can have fun by yourself in the afternoon. If you don't want to go out, you can stay in the hotel."
Xia Tian looked at Quan Tianrui's expression and knew that there was something to deal with.
Naturally, she would not force him to accompany her unreasonably, so she nodded.
"I know, go ahead and do your work!"
It was rare for him to spare a few days to spend with himself.
Quan Tianrui put away his cell phone, stepped forward to hug Xia Tian, ​​and kissed her lips deeply.
Regarding Quan Tianrui's touch, Xia Tian no longer refused as before, although she had never really refused.
"Honey, I'm sorry. I'll make it up to you when I get back."
Then Xia Tian let go, Xia Tian also guessed that the matter might be a bit serious, and quickly waved his hand.
Moreover, it's not like they really have any feelings for each other, so naturally she won't be very disappointed.
"Go quickly!"
Who knows, Quan Tianrui raised his eyebrows with a somewhat evil smile.
"Pay with flesh."
In an instant, Xia Tian's face turned red with embarrassment, and she directly picked up the pillow and threw it towards Quan Tianrui.
Quan Tianrui reached out and knocked down the flying pillow, then turned around and went to the study in a happy mood.
title_en: Chapter 13 Berlin Cathedral Chapter 14 Don’t be afraid that I’m coming
